text: Despite the established clinical procedures and theoretical foundations of GIM, a systematic framework elucidating how it modulates the dysfunctional neural circuits characteristic of MDs remains absent. This systematic review therefore aims to develop an integrative neural circuit-targeted model for GIM in MDs by synthesizing existing neuroimaging evidence. Evaluate clinical efficacy and transdiagnostic potential across diverse mood disorder populations and symptom domains.
source_label: Guided Imagery and Music modulates neural circuits in mood disorders: a systematic review of mechanisms and clinical efficacy
